title: Air-fryer fillet steak
subtitle: The most tender cut, cooked to rare or medium-rare in the air fryer.
excerpt: Beef fillet cooked in a hot air fryer for a darkened crust and a soft, pink centre. The leanest and most tender of the steaks, best served rare or medium-rare. Serves two.
sourceNotes: Beef fillet (tenderloin) comes from the psoas major muscle, which does little work and so stays exceptionally tender. It is the most expensive of the common steaks and benefits from brief, high-heat cooking to a rare or medium-rare finish.

content.text: Fillet steak cooks faster than rump or sirloin because it is thinner and leaner: no fat cap to slow the heat. Use a thermometer. The difference between rare and medium-rare in a fillet is a matter of two or three degrees and a couple of minutes.

Target temperatures for a 200 g fillet at 230°C: rare (52°C) at 7-8 minutes total; medium-rare (57°C) at 9-10 minutes; medium (63°C) at 11-12 minutes. Rest for 5 minutes ,  the temperature rises another 3-5 degrees during rest.

items.prepNote: two steaks, about 200 g each, at room temperature

content.text: Rest the {{beef-fillet}} steaks at room temperature for 30 minutes. Pat dry, brush with {{olive-oil}} of olive oil, and season with {{sea-salt-flakes}} of flaked salt and black pepper. Preheat the air fryer to 230°C for 3 minutes. Cook the steaks for 4 minutes, flip, and cook for a further 3-6 minutes until the thermometer reads your target temperature. Rest on a warm plate for 5 minutes.

items.fix: Always rest fillet at room temperature for 30 minutes. The lean meat reacts faster to surface heat than a well-marbled cut.

items.symptom: Overcooked ,  grey all the way through
items.cause: Ran full time without checking temperature.
items.fix: Use a thermometer. Fillet moves through the temperature range quickly; guessing time leads to overcooking.

items.cause: Fryer not preheated or surface was wet.
items.fix: Pat dry thoroughly. Preheat to maximum and let the basket heat too before adding the steak.

content.text: Fillet steak is a special-occasion piece of meat in most households. The air fryer method is reliable and produces a better result than an inexperienced cook might get in a pan. Serve with roast potatoes and a simple watercress salad, or with a red wine pan sauce made separately in a small saucepan.
